intervention_first: Men's Sheds: community workshops where men, mostly older and retired, meet to do practical activities such as woodwork and gardening together.
outcome_first: Improve the health and well-being of older men who are retired or out of work and who seldom use health services, in countries such as Australia, the UK and Ireland.
based_on: The review's description of Men's Sheds and its aims (via the rich brief in case.draft.json). Source PDF not re-read.
notes: 'Men's Sheds' kept: a widely known type of programme that a user would name. Social contact, skills and mental health left out: they are mediating boxes.
written_by: Claude (lead session); not yet checked by the owner
